newsitem.title: USA: Citizens Banking to acquire CB Financial.
newsitem.headline: Citizens Banking to acquire CB Financial.

text.p: Citizens Banking Corp said Monday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire CB Financial Corp in an exchange of stock.
Under terms of the agreement, CB Financial shareholders will receive 1.489 shares of Citizens Banking for each CB Financial common share, the companies said.

Flint, Michigan-based Citizens said it would issue about 4.2 million common shares of its stock for all the outstanding shares of CB Financial. Based on Citizens' closing price Monday of 30-1/2, the deal is worth about $127.2 million to Jackson, Michigan-based CB Financial's shareholders.

The combined entity will have total assets of $4.31 billion, including loans of $3.23 billion and total deposits of $3.60 billion, the banks said. The resulting company will be capitalized with total shareholders' equity of $390 million.

CB Financial with $826 million in assets as of December 31, is the parent company of City Bank and Trust Company in Jackson, Michigan, City Bank in St. Johns/Lansing, Michigan and CB North in Charlevoix, Michigan.
The combined company will operate a distribution network with banking offices in 21 Michigan counties, 123 ATM units and telephone banking capabilities, the banks said.

The transaction is subject to approval by regulatory authorities, the shareholders of both Citizens Banking and CB Financial and the satisfactory completion of due diligence procedures by Citizens, the banks said, adding that the merger is expected to be completed by the end of the second quarter of 1997.
